identity_marker: bright yellow and green Kaytee Forti-Diet Pro Health hamster food bag, silver metal tablespoon, small white ceramic food bowl, and golden Syrian hamster
continuity_anchors: set against a brightly lit indoor wooden table next to a wire hamster cage filled with fluffy white paper bedding
video_goal: Demonstrate the precise process of measuring and serving Kaytee Forti-Diet Pro Health food to a Syrian hamster.
single_prompt: A pair of hands places a bright yellow and green bag of Kaytee Forti-Diet Pro Health hamster food on a table next to a clean, empty ceramic bowl. The right hand grips the top edge of the Kaytee Forti-Diet bag and pulls apart the resealable zipper. The right hand lowers a metal tablespoon into the open bag and pushes it deep into the seed and pellet mixture. The hand lifts the tablespoon out of the bag, revealing a heaping scoop of the varied seeds, corn, and green pellets. The hand tilts the tablespoon, pouring the dry food mixture directly into the center of the ceramic bowl. The hand repeats the motion, scooping a second tablespoon of food from the bag and emptying it into the bowl to fill it halfway. Both hands pinch the top edges of the Kaytee Forti-Diet bag and slide their fingers across the seal to close it tightly. The right hand grasps the rim of the filled ceramic bowl, lifts it off the table, and moves it through the open door of a wire hamster cage. The hand lowers the bowl and sets it flat on top of the fluffy paper bedding inside the cage, then withdraws. A golden Syrian hamster walks out from a wooden hideout, approaches the ceramic bowl, and sniffs the food. The Syrian hamster reaches into the bowl with its front paws, grabs a large green pellet, and holds it up to its mouth. The Syrian hamster pushes the pellet into its mouth, visibly bulging its left cheek pouch outward.
